core_obligations: Record that flatness is preserved by base change (proof lines 10420-10421).
Identify the fibre of the base changed map at a prime with the base change of the fibre along the residue field extension (proof lines 10422-10430).
Note that the residue field extension is finitely generated because the base change map is of finite type, and conclude Noetherianity of the fibre (proof lines 10431-10434).
Apply the stability of geometric regularity to finish (proof lines 10435-10437).
proof_roadmap: Identification and Noetherianity of the fibres (proof lines 10422-10434).
Geometric regularity of the fibres (proof lines 10435-10437).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the base change of a regular ring map along a finite type map is again regular. The proof checks the two defining properties: flatness is preserved under any base change, and the fibres over primes of the base change are identified with base changes of the fibres of the original map along the residue field extension, which is finitely generated because the base change map is of finite type. Noetherianity of those fibres follows from the Noetherianity assumption on the fibres of the original map and a standard lemma on Noetherian algebras over a field extension, while geometric regularity is preserved by the corresponding stability result.
